case.summary: This case was triggered by the real-time model scoring online transaction 3478782 ($292.36) at 0.79. The graph and case analysis noted that while the amount is well above the card's 90th percentile ($74.60) and the card has 1 earlier confirmed fraud case, the case-memory model gives a calibrated fraud rate of 2.0%. The verdict is legitimate because the cardholder confirmed the transaction as their own during step-up authentication. Consequently, the transaction was allowed and the case was closed with no fraud.
